Name: Wide Wallpaper Pack
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a content pack designed for Custom Wallpaper Framework that adds 10 custom wallpapers with various resolutions and widths.

The set contains the following wallpapers:

[list]
[*]Aquarium - underwater scene, ordinary resolution, 3 panels wide
[*]Harvey Balloon - forest and mountains, 4x resolution, 10 panels wide
[*]Joja - Joja logo, ordinary resolution, 6 panels wide
[*]Joja 2 - Joja logo and slogan, ordinary resolution, 6 panels wide
[*]Night Scene Maru - night sky scene, 4x resolution, 7 panels wide
[*]Night Scene Maru 2 - night scene with trees, 2x resolution, 10 panels wide
[*]Sebastian Mountain - night sky with moon, 4x resolution, 20 panels wide
[*]Sebastian Ride - moon with trees, 4x resolution, 7 panels wide
[*]Tropical with Boat - palm tree and sailing boat, ordinary resolution, 2 panels wide
[*]Tropical without Boat - palm tree and ocean, ordinary resolution, 2 panels wide
[/list]
For the wider wallpapers, it's okay to put them on narrower walls.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12510]Custom Wallpaper Framework[/url]﻿.
